name: Tomasz Stanczak
description:
Tomasz K. Stańczak is the founder of Complete Robot, an AI-native company accelerating data centre and energy infrastructure buildout. Established through the HF0 residency in San Francisco, the company brings together land, power and project delivery, combining AI and robotics with experienced engineers and operators.

He is also the founder of Nethermind, an Ethereum core development and infrastructure company behind one of the protocol’s leading execution client teams— and previously served as Co-Executive Director of the Ethereum Foundation.
